stanza: An empty wagon full of rattling bones
Moon in the mirror on a three-hour jones
I dream a highway back to you

cinder.line: And this place where I now live, it'll burn to ash and cinder
stanza: When my morning comes around, I will look back on this valley
At these sidewalks and alleys where I've lingered so long
And this place where I now live, it'll burn to ash and cinder
Like some ghost, I won't remember when my morning comes around
